title: MTP per-submit timing profile
verdict: The prior 5-9 ms integration-overhead estimate was an artifact of subtracting medians from a different harness run. In this timestamped run, round time is accounted for by dual verification, draft, rollback, and the 2 KiB state copy; the remaining host/queue gap is approximately 0.001 ms. Optimization target is dual-token verification (45.99 ms), not host gating or rollback.
